leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Tabs component that serves as a container for compound component structure
Define a TabList component to render the navigation tabs with proper TypeScript interfaces
Implement a Tab component to represent individual tab items with click handlers
Use React context to share state between compound components without prop drilling
Apply state management to track the currently active tab index
Handle click events on Tab components to update the active tab state
Control conditional rendering to display content for the active tab only
Utilize children props to compose Tab and TabPanel components within Tabs
Implement a TabPanel component that renders content based on the active tab
Assign proper TypeScript types to component props for type safety
Access context values within child components to determine active state
Return a complete compound component structure with proper JSX composition
